_note: Pre-consolidation evaluations-results log groups whose NAME no longer identifies the agent that produced the sessions inside them, so resolveAgentId() (which derives the agentId from the group name) returns the WRONG agent. The eval-packager consults this map FIRST - exact group-leaf match, else distinguishing-substring match - and only falls back to resolveAgentId() when there is no entry. Keys: results log-group leaf name or a distinguishing substring of it. Values: canonical agentId from src/config/agents.json. Keys starting with _ are metadata and MUST be ignored by the consumer. Shipped to the Lambda as env var LEGACY_RESULTS_GROUPS_B64 = base64 of this file's compact JSON (deploy/continuous-improvement/deploy.sh). Add an entry when a results group is repointed at another agent; never delete one, or a historical backfill silently re-attributes those sessions. Keep this file small - it rides in the Lambda's 4KB env budget.
